name: food-labeling
title: Nutrition labeling under US FDA rules
summary: Work out a Nutrition Facts label under the FDA's rules: declared values, percent Daily Value, calories, serving sizes, label formats, nutrient content claims and compliance tolerances.
description: Each task describes an unnamed, made-up food: its laboratory values, product category, serving and package. The AI reads eight sections of the US Food and Drug Administration's food labeling rules, 21 CFR Part 101, and gives exact answers: what the Nutrition Facts label declares after the regulation's rounding, percent Daily Value, calories, serving sizes and servings per container, which label format applies, whether a nutrient content claim meets its numbers, and whether a lab analysis is within the compliance tolerances. Every field of the answer is checked, and a wrong rounding step always fails.

families.name: Serving size
families.what: Reference amounts, serving sizes in units, cups and spoons, and servings per container.

families.name: Declared values
families.what: The amounts a Nutrition Facts label declares, rounded by range and step, with the amounts that may be declared as zero.

families.name: Percent Daily Value
families.what: Percent Daily Value from the right column of the table, from declared or actual amounts.

families.name: Calories
families.what: Calories from the general factors or from specific ones, sugar alcohols included.

families.name: Label format
families.what: Single-serving containers, dual columns, small packages and the simplified format.

families.name: Free and low claims
families.what: Whether a food meets the numbers for a free or low claim, on the right basis.

families.name: Reduced and light claims
families.what: Whether a food meets the numbers for a reduced or light claim against its reference food.

families.name: Good source and high claims
families.what: Whether a nutrient reaches the share of its Daily Value that a good source or high claim needs.

families.name: Disclosure statement
families.what: When a claim must carry a statement disclosing fat, saturated fat, cholesterol or sodium.

families.name: Compliance tolerance
families.what: Whether a composite analysis meets the declared values, by class of nutrient.
